title: TopoLoRA-SAM: Topology-Aware Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Foundation Segmenters for Thin-Structure and Cross-Domain Binary Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: LoRA in frozen SAM ViT-B plus a depthwise-separable conv adapter on the image embedding, prompt-free decoding, optional clDice.
adaptation: Use LoRA + conv adapter, drop clDice; 1024 input; multi-class head instead of binary.
evidence: R: best retina-average Dice 0.595 and overall avg Dice 0.735 vs Mask2Former 0.709; LoRA +4.2 Dice over decoder-only; conv adapter +1.2 BFScore. Absolute retina numbers are low.
min_experiment: LoRA+conv-adapter arm in the PEFT grid vs plain LoRA; crack IoU, relF1@2; kill if < plain LoRA + 0.01.
prior_overlap: Soft clDice failed here (Loss row), so the clDice part is closed; LoRA + adapter is open.

alt_notes.adaptation: SAM ViT-B/L at 1024, 24-class decoder, no clDice (soft clDice failed here), LoRA rank 16 and 32, house loss.
alt_notes.min_experiment: LoRA-SAM + conv adapter vs house PF, 5-fold CV then 3 seeds; default kill line (CV crack relF1@2 -0.005, E1 +0.03).
